source_task: Single WeChat Channels video draft-save recovery on macOS
scope: WeChat Channels only; a logged-in headed browser page with an uploaded video and a working Kimi WebBridge session.
evidence: The target account was confirmed from the page before upload.
A browser bridge could inspect the page and fill regular fields, but could not reliably attach a local file through the page's file input.
A real CoreGraphics mouse event opened the native macOS file chooser; pasting the absolute path through the clipboard preserved non-ASCII path components.
The first save attempt was rejected by a platform validation message requiring a short title of at least six characters.
After correcting the required short title, one real save click produced a draft-list count of one and a new timestamped card.
proposed_action: Keep sau as the default path and use a real browser plus OS-level input only as a recovery path when the CLI cannot complete a page interaction.

In the recovery path, use the browser bridge for semantic inspection, account confirmation, field validation, and final draft-list verification; use OS-level trusted input for native file selection and any button that synthetic clicks fail to activate.
Paste, rather than type, absolute file paths containing non-ASCII characters into native macOS dialogs.
Validate the platform's short-title minimum before the sole intended save action; distinguish a validation-rejected click from a successful save request.
Treat the draft-list count plus a newly created card/timestamp as the completion proof when the list UI does not expose the title.
counterexamples: Do not generalize this recovery path to all platforms, browsers, operating systems, or file dialogs.
Do not use it to bypass account verification, draft-first policy, publish confirmation, deduplication, or one-save-and-verify pacing.
Do not infer that every title field has the same minimum-length rule; inspect the current platform validation first.
risk: OS coordinates and browser chrome geometry vary by machine; an unverified trusted click can activate the wrong UI. WebBridge commands can also stall during navigation. The recovery path must retain screenshots or semantic checks before every state-changing click.
recommended_validation: Forward-test only in a disposable, user-authorized draft task on macOS.
Confirm account identity before upload and draft-list evidence after exactly one valid save request.
Verify a Chinese-path upload and a short-title validation case without publishing.
rollback: Delete this candidate or mark it rejected; it is not loaded by the Skill and does not change runtime behavior.
